message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine features three men standing in a grassy field against a yellow-toned sky. The word "TEMPO" is written in large red block letters behind them. At the top left, text reads "Antek Asing Versi Prabowo H.26," and on the top right, "Konflik Kepentingan Pencalonan Thomas Djiwandono H.68." Birds fly across the sky.

The leftmost man is profile-facing right, wearing a light-colored shirt and dark trousers, with a notably large, rounded belly. The middle man, also in profile, stands straight with arms behind his back. The third man, on the right, wears glasses and points forward with his right hand. 

Below them, a body of water reflects the scene. However, instead of reflecting the men, the water shows reflections of large palm trees. Large black text at the bottom right reads "GAGAL PADI TUMBUH SAWIT." Smaller text below explains, "Zulkifli Hasan memperluas lumbung pangan dan energi di hutan Papua Selatan. Menteri Pertanian Amran Sulaiman mengusulkan perkebunan sawit raksasa. H.78." A barcode and date "26 JANUARI - 1 FEBRUARI 2024" are in the bottom left corner.
